execution.timing_scope: 8401.32 seconds belongs only to the resumed process. The sum includes both training processes, not pauses, CPU audits or total wall-clock campaign time.

optimizer_coverage.scope: Exact metadata comparison to SHA-pinned actual own early checkpoint; step values checked separately at full budget

reference_weight_comparison.comparison_scope: post-training only; no reference was used for initialization or continuation

historical_loss_comparison.unit_note: UNO saved per-trajectory 20-step mean /20; unit conversion, not recovery of unsaved sum/(1000*20) rounding. Only one original UNO scientific loss per epoch is counted.

historical_profile_limitation: The published full-run runtime block is missing. Earlier bounded reports did not capture all environment variables or interop threads; this is actual current provenance, not invented historical provenance.
packaging_scope: Existing JSON-derived evidence only. No weights, training data, private paths, run/device UUIDs or upstream source included. No repeat terminal audit, tensor load, model import, inference or training performed during packaging.
